content:
iPhone Duo is just a few weeks away from launch, and as a long-time iPad mini supporter, I'm looking forward to seeing how it recreates the iPad experience when unfolded. Here's a comparison of the iPhone Duo's foldable screen with the iPad mini's size.

Placing the iPhone Duo side by side with the iPad mini, the two are similar in size, though the Duo is slightly smaller.

The iPhone Duo is a true 2-in-1 device—the outer screen delivers the traditional iPhone experience, while unfolding the foldable display unlocks iPad mini-like functionality.

But just how similar are the two devices in size?

Below are the overall height and width specifications Apple provides for both devices:

iPhone Duo iPad mini Height 4.64 inches 5.3 inches Width 6.48 inches 7.69 inches

However, since the iPhone Duo has much thinner bezels, the gap in screen size may not be as significant as you might expect.

  • iPhone Duo: 7.6-inch display
  • iPad mini: 8.3-inch display

Below is a video posted on X by Adrián Santos showing the two devices side by side:
